Strategy: Aim for a post-placement leftover equal to the current tightest residual, so bins converge on a common leftover size that future items can match. It may help by standardizing residuals, but may fail if the tightest residual is an unusually small size to copy.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(r - item - min(bins)) for r in bins]
```
